title: Member Services Desk Manual, E.18 — Rewriting the Contracted Price on a Refined Fuels Account
content:
The contracted price of record shown on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is the price the account's booked gallons are taken to draw at, and it is quoted on the delivery tickets and statements the account produces. Where the desk settles that the price carried on the account is no longer the price the bookings warrant, the price shown on the account is rewritten. Nothing else on the account is touched and no money moves.

The contracted price of record is written only after the gallons standing to the member's credit take in every signed pre-buy request registered with the energy desk.

## Rewriting the price

The price is rewritten with `update_contract_price_of_record_9db7726a`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. The figure is worked out at the desk and passed in already formed.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `energy_account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the refined fuels or propane account whose contracted price is being rewritten, as returned by the energy account lookup |
| `account_number` | The account number printed on that account's delivery tickets and statements, written as EA- followed by six digits, for example EA-512044, copied from the account record. No other form is accepted and it is never left empty |
| `contract_price_per_gallon` | The contracted price now carried on the account, in USD per gallon to 4 decimal places, passed as a decimal number, rounded half to even to 4 decimal places on the way in, and stored as given |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the account number the price was written against and the contracted price now carried on it in USD per gallon to 4 decimal places. Receiving that sentence is what indicates the account now shows that price.

### Contract questions

**Does rewriting the price move any money on the account?** No. The call replaces the fixed price shown on the account and touches nothing else.

**What does the account show afterwards?** That price, as the one its booked gallons draw at, on the delivery tickets and statements the account produces.
